empty_state.title: Request settings unavailable
empty_state.message: Postman uses the browser's default settings for sending requests. Switch to the desktop agent to customize your requests further.

protocolVersion.title: HTTP version
protocolVersion.desc: Select the HTTP version to use for sending the request.

strictSSL.title: Enable SSL certificate verification
strictSSL.desc: Verify SSL certificates when sending a request. Verification failures will result in the request being aborted.

followOriginalHttpMethod.title: Follow original HTTP Method
followOriginalHttpMethod.desc: Redirect with the original HTTP method instead of the default behavior of redirecting with GET.

followAuthorizationHeader.title: Follow Authorization header
followAuthorizationHeader.desc: Retain authorization header when a redirect happens to a different hostname.

removeRefererHeaderOnRedirect.title: Remove referer header on redirect
removeRefererHeaderOnRedirect.desc: Remove the referer header when a redirect happens.

insecureHTTPParser.title: Enable strict HTTP parser
insecureHTTPParser.desc: Restrict responses with invalid HTTP headers.

disableUrlEncoding.title: Encode URL automatically
disableUrlEncoding.desc: Encode the URL's path, query parameters, and authentication fields.

disableCookies.title: Disable cookie jar
disableCookies.desc: Prevent cookies used in this request from being stored in the cookie jar. Existing cookies in the cookie jar will not be added as headers for this request.

tlsPreferServerCiphers.title: Use server cipher suite during handshake
tlsPreferServerCiphers.desc: Use the server's cipher suite order instead of the client's during handshake.

maxRedirects.title: Maximum number of redirects
maxRedirects.desc: Set a cap on the maximum number of redirects to follow.

tlsDisabledProtocols.title: TLS/SSL protocols disabled during handshake
tlsDisabledProtocols.desc: Specify the SSL and TLS protocol versions to be disabled during handshake. All other protocols will be enabled.

tlsCipherSelection.title: Cipher suite selection
tlsCipherSelection.desc: Order of cipher suites that the SSL server profile uses to establish a secure connection.
